text:
sara-marketing: Quick sync — planning 90min launch webinar on 2026-06-15. Need reg page copy (EN/ES), Zoom setup, caption/subtitle flow, auto-replay package, and lead routing. Who can take what?
tim-ops: I can do Zoom/webhook. Suggest passcode OFF, unique join links, cloud recording + transcript.
anya-growth: Reg form: capture locale, event_intent (benchmark|demo), preferred_contact_window, consent checkbox: "Yes, send me highlights and follow-ups." Add hidden utm fields.
video-team: We can produce 3 localized clips + 1 30s AE-spark per session. Need VTT and speaker markers.
opsbot: opsbot: On recording complete will upload raw mp4 + vtt to s3://events/launch-2026/full/{locale}/{meeting_id}.mp4 and emit SNS topic /events/clip-ready.
hubspot-bot: hubspot-bot: Created properties: event_intent, preferred_contact_window, event_score. Zapier webhook template ready.
anya-growth: Follow-up flow: immediate thank-you + calendar; 24h highlight email with clips; 48h routing: event_score >=75 -> AE; >=55 -> SDR; else nurture.
legal: Consent copy ok; include privacy link and unsubscribe in emails.
sara-marketing: Naming convention for clips: {event}/{locale}/{YYYYMMDD}/clip_{n}_{start}_{end}.mp4 with sidecar JSON. Video-team please confirm SLA for trims.
video-team: SLA 24h for AE-spark trims if clip_priority flagged. We'll tag clips with clip_priority in metadata.
sara-marketing: Great — tim provision Zoom + webhook by 6/1; anya local reg pages by 6/3; hubspot test by 6/4. I'll drop final EN/ES copy here.
